description: This file defines the class AOP_Case_Updates, which extends a Basic class and is part of the SuiteCRM project. It implements functionalities for managing case updates, including saving updates, processing HTML descriptions, retrieving related beans (such as cases, contacts, and users), and sending email notifications related to case updates.

classes.name: AOP_Case_Updates
classes.description: Represents case update records within the SuiteCRM system, providing methods to save updates, process descriptions, retrieve related data such as case and contact information, and send email notifications.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, in this case 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the case update record after cleaning HTML in the name and description, and triggers email notifications via hooks.

methods.name: parseDescription
methods.description: Fixes unclosed HTML tags in the description field by parsing and cleaning the HTML content.

methods.name: getCase
methods.description: Retrieves the related case bean using the case_id.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts linked to the associated case.

methods.name: getUpdateContact
methods.description: Retrieves the contact associated with this update, if any.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user who is assigned to the case.

methods.name: getUpdateUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user assigned to this specific case update.

methods.name: getEmailForUser
methods.description: Gets the primary email address for the user related to this case update.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates an email template with data from the case update, including subject and body content.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email notification related to the case update using specified template and recipient email addresses.
